title: File Handling — Reading from a TXT file

files.main.py:
names = []
ages = []

with open("sample.txt", "r") as file:
    for line in file:
        data = line.strip().split(",")
        names.append(data[0])
        ages.append(int(data[1]))

print("Names:", names)
print("Ages: ", ages)

# Find the oldest person
oldest_index = 0
for i in range(1, len(ages)):
    if ages[i] > ages[oldest_index]:
        oldest_index = i

print()
print("Oldest:", names[oldest_index], "—", ages[oldest_index], "years old")
